dialogue.content: （本日は、ありがとうございます。 よろしくお願い致します。 定刻になったら、始めさせて頂きますね。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for coming today. I'm looking forward to our session. We will begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。 本日はご相談にお越し下さり、ありがとうございます。  はじめに、年齢、性別、ご相談内容を聞かせていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。17歳、女子、学校行くのがつまらない。です。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'm 17, female, and going to school is boring.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます。学校へ行くのつまらないのですね。それは、お辛いですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. It sounds like going to school is boring. That must be tough.

dialogue.content: もう少し詳しく聞かせたいただきたいのですが、宜しければ、どう言った理由でつまらないのか聞かせていただけませんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'd like to understand a bit more. If you’re comfortable, could you tell me what makes it feel boring?

dialogue.content: 理由は、よく分からない
いじめられてもいない
dialogue.English: It's not like I'm being bullied or anything.

dialogue.content: よく分からないのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you're not sure why.

dialogue.content: でも、学校が面倒くさい
dialogue.English: But school feels like a hassle.

dialogue.content: 行き違い、失礼致しました。
学校が面倒くさいと感じられてるているのですね。
dialogue.English: So you feel that school is a hassle.
I just feel sluggish about it.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます。それは、いつ頃からでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing. About when did you start feeling this way?

dialogue.content: うーん3年になってからかな
dialogue.English: Hmm, maybe since I became a third-year.

dialogue.content: ３年生になってからなのですね。
dialogue.English: So it started when you became a third-year.

dialogue.content: なるほど、学校には行けているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Are you managing to go to school?
I'm going, for the most part.

dialogue.content: 学校へは行けているのですね。つまらないとお感じになっているのにそこは素晴らしいですね＾＾
dialogue.English: So you are managing to go to school. That's admirable, especially since you find it boring. ^^

dialogue.content: 例えば、今後の進路はどうお考えですか？
dialogue.English: For example, what are your thoughts on your future path?
I'll... take the entrance exams, I think.
Everyone else is doing it, too.

dialogue.content: なるほど、進学をお考えなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you're thinking of continuing your education.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます＾＾
今後の何かやりたい事や、将来なりたい自分というの漠然とでも良いので何かありますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything you'd like to do in the future, or a vision of the person you'd like to become—even if it's just a vague idea?

dialogue.content: うーんこれってモノが今はないかな…
dialogue.English: Hmm, I don't think there's anything specific right now...

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。有難うございます＾＾今はないと言う事でしたが、その前は何か没頭されていた事があったり知るのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you. ^^ You said there isn't anything right now, but was there something you were really passionate about before?
I was doing club activities all the time,

dialogue.content: それがめちゃくちゃ楽しかった
ありがとうございます＾＾部活をされていたのですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. ^^ So you were in a school club.

dialogue.content: それが、毎日楽しくて、、、ちなみに何の競技をされていたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So it was fun every day... By the way, what kind of activity was it?
Well, it wasn't really a sport...

dialogue.content: 吹奏楽ですか＾＾失礼しました。
部活が楽しくて毎日毎日素敵ですね＾＾吹奏楽ですと、お仲間との絆も強かったのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's wonderful that your club was so fun every single day. ^^ With a wind ensemble, I imagine you must have had a strong bond with your fellow members.
I was with my friends every day,
and even when practice was tough,
I retired at the end of my second year,

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。毎日一つの目標に向かって友達と毎日楽しく、充実されていたのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you felt fulfilled, working toward a common goal with your friends every day, and having fun.

dialogue.content: みんなで練習するのが
今思うとめちゃくちゃ楽しかったなって
dialogue.English: looking back now, I realize it was so much fun.

dialogue.content: 思いを有難うございます＾＾それが、急に無くなるのはぽっかり穴が空いてしまった様な感覚なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your feelings. ^^ For that to suddenly be gone, does it feel like a big empty hole has been left behind?

dialogue.content: なんか毎日つまらなくなっちゃだて
dialogue.English: It's like every day just became boring.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それはそうなっても仕方ないですよね
dialogue.English: I see. It's understandable that you would feel that way.

dialogue.content: 毎日、充実されていた物目標、あるものが無くなってしまって何に、向かっていっていいか分からな感覚でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Something that made each day fulfilling—the goals and the structure—has disappeared, and now it’s hard to know what to direct yourself toward. Is that the feeling?
I’m going to cram school, but...

dialogue.content: 毎日勉強勉強勉強勉強
dialogue.English: it’s just study, study, study, study every day,
the goal feels so far away,

dialogue.content: 絶対間に合わないから
dialogue.English: I'll definitely never make it in time.

dialogue.content: やる事(勉強)はいっぱいあるのに
dialogue.English: and even though there’s so much studying I have to do,

dialogue.content: やる気がしないって言うか
間に合わなかったらどーしよーとも思う
dialogue.English: And I worry, what if I don't make it in time?

dialogue.content: 焦ってしまうのですね
そうなのですね。なぜ、勉強をしないと行けないのかなぜ、大学に行かないと行けないのかがないと、中々やる気が出てこないですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's hard to feel motivated when you don't have a clear reason why you have to study or why you have to go to university, isn't it?

dialogue.content: とりあえず勉強してる感じだから
dialogue.English: It feels like I'm just studying for the sake of it.

dialogue.content: もう一度、聞かせて頂きたいのですが
dialogue.English: I'd like to ask you again, if you don't mind.

dialogue.content: 吹奏楽部の時は目標があったりしたのでしょうか＾＾
dialogue.English: When you were in the wind ensemble, did you have goals? ^^

dialogue.content: どんな、目標か聞かせていただいて良いでしょうか＾＾
dialogue.English: Could you tell me what kind of goals they were? ^^
we’d have a competition in three months, for example.

dialogue.content: また2〜3ヶ月後に文化祭があって…
dialogue.English: then two or three months later there’d be the cultural festival...

dialogue.content: ここまでに仕上げなきゃ
dialogue.English: We had to get it finished by a certain time,
and there were many of them,

dialogue.content: みんなで曲決めて練習したり
dialogue.English: we would all decide on the music and practice together,

dialogue.content: 素敵ですね＾＾もちろん、吹奏楽自体のお好きだったのでしょうが何か目標に向かってみんなで取り組んでいけたのが凄く楽しかったんですね。
dialogue.English: That's wonderful. ^^ Of course, I'm sure you loved the wind ensemble itself, but it sounds like what was really fun was working together with everyone toward a shared goal.

dialogue.content: みんなで同じ思いで頑張ってる時が
dialogue.English: When we were all working hard with the same goal in mind,

dialogue.content: 辛い事も乗り越えられると言うか
dialogue.English: we could overcome the tough parts,

dialogue.content: 達成した時もみんなで喜べるし
dialogue.English: and when we achieved something, we could all celebrate together.

dialogue.content: って充実感がすっごくあった
dialogue.English: and I felt a great sense of accomplishment.

dialogue.content: これは、私の主観ですが凄く素敵な高校生活を送られたんだなとお見受けしています＾＾
dialogue.English: This is just my impression, but it sounds like you had a truly wonderful high school experience. ^^

dialogue.content: 2年までは、本当に毎日楽しかった
dialogue.English: Up until my second year, every day really was so much fun.

dialogue.content: 受験って一人一人っていうか
みんなで頑張るって感じじゃないし
dialogue.English: it’s not something you work on together,
it's more like everyone's a rival.

dialogue.content: 1人受験をやめる勇気もない
dialogue.English: I don't have the courage to be the only one to quit.

dialogue.content: みんな敵、そうお感じになられているのですね
dialogue.English: So you're feeling like everyone is a rival.

dialogue.content: なるほどそれは、お辛いし、寂しいですよね
dialogue.English: I see. That must be tough and lonely.

dialogue.content: 部活の連帯感みたいなのがなくて
dialogue.English: There's none of that camaraderie we had in the club,

dialogue.content: 仕方がないって分かってるんだけど
dialogue.English: I know it can't be helped, but...

dialogue.content: 寂しいとお感じになられているのですね
これまでも、目標を持って頑張ってこられた相談者さんです。
dialogue.English: You've always been someone who works hard toward your goals.

dialogue.content: 今は、受験のために受験をやっている状態
dialogue.English: Right now, it feels like you’re preparing for exams just for the sake of the exams.

dialogue.content: 何の為に、大学へ入るか何の為に知見を身につけるか
dialogue.English: What you're going to university for, or why you want to gain this knowledge...

dialogue.content: これを、考えてみては如何でしょうか？＾＾
dialogue.English: how about taking some time to think about that? ^^

dialogue.content: そして、それを今まで２年時間を共有した友達に
dialogue.English: And then, with the friends you've spent the last two years with...

dialogue.content: 共有してみては如何でしょうか？同じ、目標を持って頑張ってこられたお仲間です。共感し合えるところ何かもあるのではないかと感じました＾＾
dialogue.English: how about trying to share that with them? They are your companions who worked hard toward the same goals. I feel there might be some things you can empathize with each other about. ^^
Since I retired from the club,

dialogue.content: あんまり時間が合わなくて
dialogue.English: our schedules haven't really lined up,
so we haven't really been able to see each other.

dialogue.content: みんな忙しそうだから
そーいう話も出来てなかったな
dialogue.English: so we haven't really been able to talk about this kind of thing.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね＾＾もし、相談者さんに友達からご連絡が来たらどうですか？嬉しいですか？
dialogue.English: I see. ^^ If a friend reached out to you, how would you feel? Would it make you happy?

dialogue.content: もしかしたら、その友達も相談者さんや周りに
dialogue.English: Perhaps your friends are also thinking of you and others,

dialogue.content: 気を遣って、同じ寂しい気持ちでも連絡していないと言うことがあるかもしれませんね＾＾
dialogue.English: and even if they're feeling the same loneliness, they might be hesitating to contact you out of consideration. ^^

dialogue.content: 忙しいところ連絡来たら嬉しい？
dialogue.English: would you be happy if someone contacted you when you were busy?

dialogue.content: それだけの思いがある友達なら凄く嬉しいです＾＾
dialogue.English: If it were from a friend I care that much about, I'd be very happy. ^^

dialogue.content: 嬉しいって言われると
dialogue.English: Hearing you say you'd be happy

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、聞いて頂き有難うございます＾＾
dialogue.English: No, thank you for listening to me. ^^

dialogue.content: 是非、ご連絡してみてください。今日みたいな、お友達に対しての想いや、今後の将来の事も共有されてみては如何かなと思います＾＾
dialogue.English: Please, do try contacting them. I think it would be good to share your feelings about your friends, like you did today, and your thoughts about the future, too. ^^

dialogue.content: 友達の話も聞きたいし
dialogue.English: I want to hear how my friends are doing, too.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます。もしかしたら
その、お友達も相談者さんのように

dialogue.English: have lost their sense of purpose,
and are feeling bored and sluggish.

dialogue.content: そうお感じになられているかもしれないですよね
dialogue.English: They might be feeling that way as well.
Even if we don't have time,

dialogue.content: チョット違う気がする
dialogue.English: feels like it would make a little difference.

dialogue.content: 自分だけだと思うと不安になりますが、同じ時間を過ごした友達です
dialogue.English: It's easy to feel anxious when you think you're the only one, but these are friends you've spent so much time with.

dialogue.content: 少し、出方は違っても共感できる所があると思いますよ＾＾
dialogue.English: Even if your situations are slightly different, I'm sure you'll find things you can relate to. ^^
I’m not the only one taking exams;

dialogue.content: 自分だけじゃないしね
シンドイ思いしてるかもな…
dialogue.English: They might be having a hard time, too...

dialogue.content: 是非、想いや将来を分かち合ってみてください。相談者さんのような友達がそばにいたら、友達も心強いと思いますよ＾＾
dialogue.English: Please do try to share your feelings and thoughts about the future. If your friends had a friend like you by their side, I'm sure they would feel encouraged, too. ^^

dialogue.content: そー言ってもらえると
そして、お互いに力になるのではないかと思います。お役に立てて私も嬉しいです＾＾
dialogue.English: And I think you can be a source of strength for each other. I'm glad I could be of help. ^^

dialogue.content: 1人で戦ってる感あったけど
dialogue.English: I felt like I was fighting this battle alone, but...
I feel like I can keep going.

dialogue.content: そうですね＾＾相談者さんには
めちゃくちゃ勇気出た
dialogue.English: I feel so much more courageous now.

dialogue.content: ２年で築いた大切な友達がいますね＾＾
dialogue.English: the precious friends you made over those two years. ^^

dialogue.content: ズッ友なんですね＾＾素敵です。私も幸せな気持ちになりました
dialogue.English: Best friends forever, huh? ^^ That's lovely. It makes me feel happy too.

dialogue.content: 相談員さんが優しい人でよかった
dialogue.English: I'm glad you were such a kind counselor.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、相談してくださり有難うございます＾＾
dialogue.English: No, thank you for coming to talk with me. ^^

dialogue.content: 正直な想いを書いてくださり有難うございます＾＾
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your honest feelings with me. ^^

dialogue.content: 毎日つまらないな〜と思ってたけど
dialogue.English: I was thinking every day was so boring, but...
I can see a ray of light.

dialogue.content: 良かったです。私もとっても嬉しいです＾＾
dialogue.English: I'm so glad. That makes me very happy, too. ^^

dialogue.content: ぜひ、残りの高校生活も充実したものになる事を願っています＾＾逆に私も元気をいただきました
dialogue.English: I truly hope the rest of your high school life will be fulfilling. ^^ Actually, you've given me energy as well.

dialogue.content: 本日は、有難うございます＾＾お時間になりましたのでこちらで終えせていただこうと思います。
dialogue.English: Thank you for today. ^^ Our time is up, so I think we'll end our session here.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ本日は、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: No, thank you very much for today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、楽しい元気をもらえる１時間でした＾＾有難うございました＾＾
dialogue.English: The pleasure was all mine. It was a fun and energizing hour. ^^ Thank you. ^^

dialogue.content: 優しく寄り添っていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for being so kind and understanding.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます＾＾（ お手数をおかけしてしまいますが、率直なFBを頂けると幸いです。 また機会がありましたら、どうぞよろしくお願い致します。）
dialogue.English: Thank you. ^^ (I know it can be a bother, but I would appreciate it if you could provide some honest feedback. I hope we have the chance to talk again. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: こちらこそまた機会がありましたらよろしくお願いします(emoji)
dialogue.English: Same here, I'd look forward to it if there's another opportunity. (emoji)

dialogue.content: では、これで終了させて頂きますね＾＾
dialogue.English: Well then, we will conclude the session now. ^^
